<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z ≈ 199.0, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 197.992 Da. The combination of elements that matches this mass most closely, while obeying the nitrogen rule (even nominal mass → zero or an even number of nitrogens), is C₁₁H₂O₄ (exact mass = 197.995 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value). Therefore the molecular formula is:

**C11H2O4**</thought>
<final_answer>C11H2O4</final_answer>
